rows.en: Oh, Michel-kun.
I was just thinking how bored I am...
Hey, Michel-kun.
That depends on the question.
You're a sniper, right, Michel-kun?
So that fine-tuning is what matters?

That was really educational!
You're amazing, Michel-kun!

It's pretty rare to end up
at the same high school, too~
Why are you always fighting with Saotome-kun?
But Saotome-kun always seems angry...

(Looks to me like he's getting worked up
about it, though...)
You too, Michel-kun.
Huh, Michel... What's up?
...Isn't there something you ought to tell me?
Sigh... Guess it can't be helped...

I heard the rumors.
You've been hanging out a lot with that woman,
haven't you?
rows.notes: x3 (also one female-variant occurrence). Michel says ano onna, blunt: 'that woman'.

rows.en:
Play your cards right, okay?
You're the one who'll be in trouble later.

Ah, yeah...
Thanks for the advice...
Huh, Michel-kun... What's up?
...Don't you have anything to tell me?

What's this all of a sudden...?
Something to tell you...? Not really... I think?
Probably...
rows.notes: Same English as the shared c00235 (slice 4); this is the -wa yo form.

rows.en:
Sigh... Well, if that's how it is,
I guess it can't be helped...

I heard the rumors.
Apparently you've been hanging out a lot
with that woman lately?

Huh? Rumors?
Who's 'that woman' supposed to be?!

Well, hang out with me once in a while too,
would ya?
rows.notes: Michel asking the player; shared m/f.

rows.en: Um, yeah. Sometime soon.
Let's hurry up and go change, Michel.
Yeah, I want to wash off this sweat already.
What's everyone doing at the locker room?
rows.notes: koui-shitsu ni nan no you da: Michel seeing the crowd.

rows.en: Hey, what happened?

Uniforms?
This is the boys' locker room, you know?!

H-hey! \p!
My uniform's gone!
Of all things, I'm stuck in this getup...
rows.notes: The Culture Fest outfit (c00254); costume not named, so 'getup'.

rows.en:
Beats your gym clothes, right?
Those are all sticky with sweat.
Well, yeah...
It looks good on you. Bet the girls'll love it.
A blessing in disguise, I guess.

It's lunchtime, so I'd be thrilled if you poured
me some tea in that outfit.
I don't do service for guys.
Aw, come on. It's not like it'll cost you anything.
Geez, you have no idea how I feel...
(Michel sure had it rough!)
Michel-kun, that was tiring, huh...
I'm not gonna peek.

It looks good on you, you know?
The girls around here are totally fired up.

It's lunchtime, so I'd be thrilled if you poured
me some tea in that outfit~
...If that is your wish...
rows.notes: go-kibou to araba, playing the part.

rows.en: Hehe!
You sure are carefree.
(Poor Michel-kun had it rough, huh.)

I heard the rumors.
You've been hanging out a lot with that guy,
haven't you?
rows.notes: x3 (also one female-variant occurrence). ano otoko.

rows.en:
Ah, yeah...
I'll invite you next time.

I heard the rumors.
Apparently you've been hanging out a lot
with that guy lately?

Huh? Rumors?
Who's 'that guy' supposed to be?!

(Huh? The one walking this way is...
Shirakawa.)
rows.notes: Shared m/f (one occurrence has no speaker).

rows.en:
(Looks like she noticed me too.
Wow, she always walks so gracefully.)

\p-kun,
grinning like that in the middle of town
will make people question your character.

It's just, I was admiring
how beautifully you walk, Shirakawa.

Beautiful? Me...?
That's not true at all.

Your posture's so straight, too.
Did you do ballet or something before?

I never did ballet, but my family has been military
for generations, so maybe it's from watching
how my father and the others walk.
rows.notes: chichi-tachi: her father and the other men of the family.

rows.en: So does a military family eat a lot of rations?
Of course not.
Or curry every Friday?
What navy is that supposed to be...
I'd eat it every week, though. Curry, I mean.
I don't particularly want it every week.

So is curry at the Shirakawa house
about once a month?

...Maybe about twice a month.
I've never really thought about it.
I see. So is the meat chicken?
The Shirakawa way is to use bone-in hippo-cow.

Whoa~
That sounds delicious!!
Of course it is! I let it sit for three days!

(Wow, she sounds really confident...
It must be seriously good...)

Since you're so curious,
shall I make it for you sometime?
rows.notes: sokomade iu nara, kondo gochisou shimashou ka.

rows.en: Huh, really?!
Yes, I don't mind.
All right! Shirakawa's curry!!
...Wait, why were we even talking about curry?
...Who knows...

uncertain: c02038/c02045/c02046: Michel's blunt 'ano onna' rendered 'that woman' (the matching 'ano otoko' as 'that guy'); who is meant is never said.
c02055/c02060: the outfit Michel borrows from the Culture Fest is not named in the scene; kept as 'this getup' / 'that outfit'.
